text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are AI systems that generate human-like text. They work by predicting the next word in a sentence, based on patterns learned from huge amounts of training data, such as books, websites and articles. Users can improve results through prompt engineering, which means writing clear and specific instructions. LLMs are good at tasks like summarizing, translating and answering questions. However, they have limitations: they can produce false information, reflect biases in their training data, and they do not truly understand what they write. For these reasons, it is important to check their output carefully.
